notes.subject: עלה נעלה
notes.rationale: Poelelo ya go tlaga: go tlaga / re tla tlaga — e phophametse thata mme e latlhegelwa ke bongwe jwa yone mo phetolelong.

notes.subject: יכול נוכל
notes.rationale: Go boa ga modi o le mongwe wa go kgona (re ka kgona / re ka kgona) — se se nonotsha polelo ya Kalebe.

notes.subject: ka bonako
notes.rationale: KJV e oketse 'at once' e le mo mokwalong; Setswana se se na le yone fela go tlhalosa go tsamaya ga bona pele ga selo se diragala — mokwalo o se na wona.

notes.subject: וירשנו
notes.rationale: Go laola go raya go gatelela batho ba ba mo gae ba bo ba nna mo lefelong la bone — e seng go fenya fela.

notes.subject: go setshaba
notes.rationale: Kalebe o bua le setshaba sa Yisraele ka tlhamalalo, a ba thibela go bua dilo tse di seng botlhoka.

translation: Mme Kalebe a thibela ⟨את⟩ setshaba fa pele ga Moshe, mme a re: A re tlage ka bonako, mme re e laole; gonne re ka kgona go e fenya.
